title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement establishing an association between the European Union and the Principality of Andorra and the Republic of San Marino respectively
part_text: 9. Emphasises the fact that the 1990 customs agreement with Andorra and the 1991 cooperation and customs agreement with San Marino have boosted the economies of these countries; considers that the new Association Agreement has the potential to further support their economic development, in particular by breaking down barriers to cross-border economic activity; points out that the benefits are disproportionately in Andorra’s and San Marino’s favour; stresses that the economic return or strategic advantage for EU citizens remains very limited;
